decisions.reason: As a low-cost complementary cleaning product tied to the installed base of wood floors, it remains worth keeping open and its continued presence suggests no strong abandonment signal.
The maintenance oil line fits the firm's core flooring-system and aftercare offer, and the firm can learn further at limited cost without giving up the option.
This care line still serves a relevant oiled-floor niche, but its narrower demand and overlap with other care products make it the most plausible candidate for later portfolio rationalisation.
With the other underlay product already withdrawn, the moisture-protection underlay has clearer system relevance and modest continuation costs, so it is sensible to retain.
The oak parquet line is close to the firm's core capabilities and strategic positioning, though its higher complexity and carrying costs justify continued review rather than full commitment.
